newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: SOCCER-MCGRATH IN IRELAND SQUAD FOR CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MCGRATH IN IRELAND SQUAD FOR CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Veteran Derby defender Paul McGrath was named in Ireland's 20-man squad on Wednesday for next month's World Cup qualifier against Macedonia in Skopje.
McGrath, 37, won a record 83rd cap for Ireland in a friendly against Wales in February.
Manager Mick McCarthy also included striker Stephen Geoghegan of Ireland premier division side Shelbourne in the squad for the group eight match on April 2.
Squad: Goalkeepers - Alan Kelly, Shay Given.
Defenders - Ken Cunningham, Jeff Kenna, Terry Phelan, Denis Irwin, Paul McGrath, Gary Breen, Ian Harte.
Midfielders - Stephen Staunton, Jason McAteer, Ray Houghton, Roy Keane, Andy Townsend, Alan McLoughlin.
Strikers - David Kelly, Jon Goodman, Tony Cascarino, Alan Moore, Stephen Geoghegan.
